name: adspower-lite
description: مدير ملفات متصفح بجلسات معزولة (Electron + React + TypeScript + SQLite)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:isolation: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-test.mjs isolation
scripts.test:db: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-test.mjs db
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:isolation
